## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setting-up-document 


setwd("C:/Users/aay6/Desktop/Blepharisma_Warming/Bleph_warming_Oct_2023_FlowCytometer/All_data")

library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(dplyr)
library(bayesplot)
library(tidybayes)
library(posterior)
library(GGally)

theme_set(theme_classic())
 
df <- read_csv("full_recluster_97p5_filtered.csv")

metric_df_FW <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Algae_Presence = case_when(
      FW %in% c("FW1", "FW2", "FW3", "FW4") ~ "No",
      FW %in% c("FW5", "FW6", "FW7", "FW8") ~ "Yes"
    ),
    number_of_predators = case_when(
      FW %in% c("FW1", "FW5") ~ "2",
      FW %in% c("FW2", "FW3", "FW6", "FW7") ~ "1",
      FW %in% c("FW4", "FW8") ~ "0"
    ),
    ID_of_predators = case_when(
      FW %in% c("FW1", "FW5") ~ "Both",
      FW %in% c("FW3", "FW7") ~ "Blepharisma",
      FW %in% c("FW2", "FW6") ~ "Euplotes",
      FW %in% c("FW4", "FW8") ~ "None"
    )
  )

dir.create("models", showWarnings = FALSE)

```

## Calculate Shannon Diversity

```{r}
#| label: calculate-shannon

# Calculate cluster abundance within each jar and sampling day
cluster_counts <- metric_df_FW %>%
  count(
    Jar,
    Day,
    FW,
    Temperature,
    Algae_Presence,
    number_of_predators,
    ID_of_predators,
    class,
    name = "abundance"
  )


# Calculate Shannon diversity from relative cluster abundances
shannon_df <- cluster_counts %>%
  group_by(
    Jar,
    Day,
    Temperature,
    FW,
    Algae_Presence,
    number_of_predators,
    ID_of_predators
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p = abundance / sum(abundance)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    shannon = -sum(p * log(p)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Format variables for statistical analysis
shannon_df <- shannon_df %>%
  mutate(
    Jar = factor(Jar),

    Day = as.numeric(Day),

    Temperature = factor(
      Temperature,
      levels = c("Stable", "Warming", "Recovery")
    ),

    Algae_Presence = factor(
      Algae_Presence,
      levels = c("No", "Yes")
    ),

    ID_of_predators = factor(
      ID_of_predators,
      levels = c("None", "Blepharisma", "Euplotes", "Both")
    ),
    number_of_predators = factor(
  number_of_predators,
  levels = c("0", "1", "2")
)
  )
```

## Shannon General Model

```{r}

## Shannon Diversity Base Model

fit_shannon_base <- brms::brm(
  shannon ~ Temperature * Day + (1 | Jar),
  data = shannon_df,
  family = gaussian(),
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  seed = 123
)

saveRDS(
  fit_shannon_base,
  "models/fit_shannon_base.rds"
)
```

## Shannon ID x Algae

```{r}
## Shannon Diversity: Predator Identity x Algae
## Candidate Model Comparison


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model 1: Separate predator identity and algae interactions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Temperature and time interact separately with predator identity and
# algae presence, without a predator identity x algae interaction.

fit_shannon_id_separate_interactions <- brms::brm(
  shannon ~
    Temperature * Day * ID_of_predators +
    Temperature * Day * Algae_Presence +
    (1 | Jar),
  data = shannon_df,
  family = gaussian(),
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  seed = 123
)

saveRDS(
  fit_shannon_id_separate_interactions,
  "models/fit_shannon_id_separate_interactions.rds"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model 2: Four-way interaction
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Allow the effects of temperature and time to depend jointly on predator
# identity and algae presence.

fit_shannon_id_fourway_interaction <- brms::brm(
  shannon ~
    Temperature * Day * ID_of_predators * Algae_Presence +
    (1 | Jar),
  data = shannon_df,
  family = gaussian(),
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
  seed = 123
)

saveRDS(
  fit_shannon_id_fourway_interaction,
  "models/fit_shannon_id_fourway_interaction.rds"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LOO model comparison
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Compare out-of-sample predictive performance of the candidate models
# using approximate leave-one-out cross-validation.

loo_shannon_id_separate <- brms::loo(
  fit_shannon_id_separate_interactions
)

loo_shannon_id_fourway <- brms::loo(
  fit_shannon_id_fourway_interaction
)

loo_shannon_id_comparison <- loo::loo_compare(
  loo_shannon_id_separate,
  loo_shannon_id_fourway
)

loo_shannon_id_comparison


# Save LOO results
saveRDS(
  loo_shannon_id_separate,
  "models/loo_shannon_id_separate_interactions.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  loo_shannon_id_fourway,
  "models/loo_shannon_id_fourway_interaction.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  loo_shannon_id_comparison,
  "models/loo_shannon_id_comparison.rds"
)
```
